original_text: हमारे इलाके में बच्चों के लिए अच्छा अस्पताल नहीं है। प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र में डॉक्टर नहीं आते।
normalized_text: There is no good hospital for children in our locality. Doctors do not visit the primary health center.
translated_text: There is no good hospital for children in our locality. Doctors do not visit the primary health center.

original_text: रोज शाम को 6 घंटे बिजली कटती है। अस्पताल में जनरेटर नहीं चल पा रहा, बच्चों की पढ़ाई ठप है।
normalized_text: Daily 6-hour power outage every evening. Local clinic generators are failing and school studies are disrupted.
translated_text: Daily 6-hour power outage every evening. Local clinic generators are failing and school studies are disrupted.

original_text: आमच्या भागात गेल्या तीन आठवड्यांपासून पिण्याच्या पाण्याची पाइपलाइन फुटली आहे. ५,००० हून अधिक कुटुंबांना पाण्याचा थेंबही मिळत नाहीये.
normalized_text: Drinking water pipeline broken in our locality for past 3 weeks. Over 5,000 households have zero clean water supply.
translated_text: Drinking water pipeline broken in our locality for past 3 weeks. Over 5,000 households have zero clean water supply.

original_text: আমাদের এলাকায় ভালো ইন্টারনেট সংযোগ নেই। ছাত্রছাত্রী এবং ক্ষুদ্র ব্যবসায়ীরা কাজ করতে পারছে না।
normalized_text: There is no good internet connection in our area. Students and small business owners are unable to work.
translated_text: There is no good internet connection in our area. Students and small business owners are unable to work.

original_text: Sem esgoto encanado nem tratamento de água no bairro. As crianças estão ficando doentes toda semana.
normalized_text: No piped sewage or water treatment in the neighborhood. Children are falling sick every week.
translated_text: No piped sewage or water treatment in the neighborhood. Children are falling sick every week.

original_text: Isibhedlela sendawo asinayo imithi yokwelapha amanzi amashushu nogesi awuthembekile.
normalized_text: The local health center has broken water pipes and unreliable electricity supply during night clinic shifts.
translated_text: The local health center has broken water pipes and unreliable electricity supply during night clinic shifts.

original_text: There is no reliable public transport in our area. Workers spend 3 hours commuting every morning.
normalized_text: There is no reliable public transport in our area. Workers spend 3 hours commuting every morning.
translated_text: There is no reliable public transport in our area. Workers spend 3 hours commuting every morning.
